{{Quote|The artifacts hidden there are more dangerous than you can imagine. If you used them, it would be at your own peril.|Tenebrae, on his vaults|<ref name="KOTET7" />}}
[[File:Sanitarium.png|thumb|right|230px|A vault existed within the Sanitarium on Nathema.]]
The '''Emperor's Vaults''', also referred to as the '''Immortal Emperor's Vaults''', were a series of mysterious vaults containing [[Tenebrae]]'s [[Sith artifact/Legends|dark relics]] that even he feared were too dangerous and powerful to use.

==History==
After constructing them, Vitiate sealed deadly guardians inside the vaults to protect the vault from intruders, where they hibernated until disturbed. Its existence was kept a closely guarded secret, so much so that its details were nothing more than a rumor among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] leaders. Likewise, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] had very little knowledge of the vaults, with expeditions to locate a vault turning up nothing, such as with [[Jen Alkier]]'s hunt.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Emperor's Vaults}}</ref>

The existence of such vaults were revealed to the [[Alliance Commander]] when the Commander sought refuge in one at the [[Sanitarium]] during the Commander's [[Mission to Nathema|hunt]] for [[Vaylin]]. The Commander found and retreived [[Dramath's holocron]] from the vault. However, this vault and the rest of the artifacts within were destroyed along with the Sanitarium during Vaylin's ritual.<ref name="KOTET7" />

[[File:Zildrog.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Zildrog, in a vault.]]
Following the Sanitarium's destruction, [[Gault Rennow]] hoped to find other vaults filled with priceless artifacts that he could sell on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Gault attempted to reach out to an old exiled [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] contact who once mentioned the existence of such structures after a few too many [[Tarisian ale]]s, a statement Gault dismissed at that time, but Gault found out that she vanished mysteriously a few days after she told Gault of those vaults.<ref name="Payday">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|Emperor's Vaults Payday|Gault Rennow}}</ref>

During the Commander's [[Order of Zildrog campaign|conflict]] against the [[Order of Zildrog]], the Commander [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|stumbled upon]] another vault under an ancient [[Ancient Temple|Sith Temple]] which housed [[Zildrog]], whom Vitiate had deactivated after his [[Ritual of Nathema]] many years ago.<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Emperor's Vaults first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''Chapter VII: Into the Void'''.
